verdict.rationale: Skills can be run with no interactive UI through the Messages API: they are passed in the `container` parameter (up to 20 per request) and executed in the code-execution environment. Custom skills are uploaded and versioned via the Skills API. The Agent SDK also documents programmatic control over which skills sessions can invoke and can load skill plugins from local directories. Separately, the CLI accepts piped, non-interactive input (`claude -p`), and a runtime probe confirmed a scripted, keyless skill install. missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline guidance or examples for skills, and independent hands-on corroboration of skills running in unattended CI automation.
